title: Poll observable HTTP request and connection instruments
goal: Update a custom MeterListener to poll current HTTP request and connection measurements when event-counter accumulation no longer matches the instruments.

selectionNotes: Poll and replace snapshots rather than accumulating them across intervals; other HTTP instruments retain their own semantics.
This sample aggregates tag sets; exporters and production dimensional storage need their own policy.
